gpt.text: In Guildpact Agrus Kos is working at Pivlic's bar, where Teysa and Melisk bring Uncle's corpse, and Teysa later sends him with Pivlic and the Grugg Brothers to rescue Crix.
He finds Hauc trying to hatch three dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact, and in the dogfight that follows the two dragons kill each other.
Kos is impaled in the crash, sees Feather emerge from the kuga mot, and dies.

dis.text: In Dissension the Azorius place Agrus Kos's spirit in the body of the ectomancer Obez Murzeddi.
Augustin tells him he broke the Guildpact by arresting Szadek, and Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowers Svogthir and kills Momir Vig, though too late to stop Project Kraj.
Szadek, released from Kos's grounder, sucks Augustin's soul out before the Parhelion explodes, and two years later Kos returns to Ravnica as a ghost to lead the police force of Agyrem.

mkm.text: In Murders at Karlov Manor, Agrus Kos arrives, assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency, and he, Kaya and Kellan agree to seek justice for Teysa's murderer.
When Aurelia grants only twenty-four hours, Kos backs Kaya's plea, and he later tells Kaya he must investigate alone because it is too dangerous for a living person.
He finds Rakdos asleep in his lava pit, but Judith, who is planting clues to frame Rakdos and take over the guild, captures him in a crystal skull.

rav.text: Agrus Kos, a Wojek investigator, is tasked with arresting the Rakdos gang leader Palla alongside Myczil Zunich, and he kills Palla by impaling her throat with a thrown sword.
Mad with guilt, Zunich tries to kill Jarad as the sole witness, and Kos tries to stop him but Zunich slips off the roof and dies.
At the Decamillennial Kos arrests the Dimir head Szadek and unwittingly breaks the Guildpact.
Kos then kills Momir Vig by stabbing him in the eye just after Vig and Svogthir activate Kraj, and he dies himself when Zomaj Hauc and the dragons crash.
